rules.coverage_text: All landlords and foreclosing owners intending to end a tenancy or post-foreclosure occupancy in Boston.

exemptions.description: Residences in hospitals, skilled nursing or health facilities, or non-profit short-term substance abuse treatment facilities.

rules.penalty: 1st offense: warning; 2nd and subsequent offenses: $300 per day
rules.quote: The Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources must be delivered at the same time as the Notice to Quit.
rules.requirement: Landlords ending a tenancy or not renewing a lease must give the tenant a Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources with the Notice to Quit, and send a copy of the notice with a Certificate of Compliance to the Office of Housing Stability.
rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act notice
